notes.title: PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33569496/b1e30e188df7876e34c37c9de0f555ac3821da1f.png

1. The translation is improved: all words that weren't translated are now translated.
2. The accuracy of riflemen and cannons is improved.
3. The build for x86 architecture is added.
4. The optimization is improved.
5. Added: use 'ESC' to open the pause menu that stops the game.
6. Added: the background under the menu to make the menu more visible.
7. Added: you can now sell units.
8. Fixed: the bug of hero's random appearance in the center of the map.

notes.title: Optimization Patch
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33569496/ac2ec81034c6c5222b84ad9d3c4183792f019d66.png

1. The performance of the game is optimized.
2. The bug with the riflemen standing in place is fixed: now they attack the enemy.
3. The display of the number of live units of the enemy is added to the upper left corner.
